description.text: Note: The course will be open only when the enrollment is up to 12. Please contact us before you apply it.a. SemesterThe school year can be divided into three semesters. The summer semester commences from early September and ends at the end of September. The autumn semester begins from early October and ends at the end of January the following year, and then the winter vacation follows. The spring semester starts in the middle of February and ends in early July, and then the summer vacation starts.b. TeachingThe teaching lasts 4 weeks for the first semester in which students may have lectures or do internships, 16 weeks for the second and third semesters in which students study all courses. Besides, there are 2 weeks suspended before the end of second and third semesters during which students can make preparation for final examinations.c. Credits RequirementsThe total number of credits for students of science and engineering is 170 or so (the number of credits for theoretical subjects is about 140 and about 30 for practice). The total number of credits for students of arts, economics and management is 160. Each student is required to complete at least 20 credits in a semester.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Nanjing University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2750 USD/per year ￥ 19800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport: The first page of the passport (valid for more than 12 months).2. Academic qualification certificate: A notarized certificate of the highest academic qualification; If the applicant is a recent graduate, they need to provide a certificate of expected graduation or a certificate of current enrollment from their school.3. Transcript: An official transcript of the high school stage (with the seal of the school's academic affairs department). If the transcript is not in Chinese or English, a notarized English translation must be attached.4. Language proficiency proof: Provide valid language proficiency test scores within two years (HSK, TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo).5. Personal Statement: Motivation for Study and Major Choice, over 800 words (in Chinese or English). Click to download the personal statement template6. Recommendation Letters: Provide two recommendation letters from high school teachers, which should explain the relationship with the applicant.7. "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" : Copy (Keep the original for yourself. This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese health and quarantine department and must be filled out in English). Applicants should undergo examinations strictly in accordance with the items required in the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners". The "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" with missing items, without the applicant's photo attached or without a cross-stitch seal on the photo, and without the signatures and seals of the doctor and the hospital is invalid. The validity period of the examination results is six months. Click to download the Physical examination form for foreigners8. Certificate of no criminal record: Issued by the local public security authority, the document must be valid within six months prior to the application.9. Financial proof: Provide financial guarantee materials (such as income certificates, deposit certificates or guarantee letters of parents or guardians).10. Other materials: such as award certificates, proof of special skills and other supporting materials.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health, have a solid academic background, voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect Chinese customs and habits.2. Language proficiency requirements:● English-taught: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 80, Duolingo 90 or equivalent● Taught in Chinese: HSK level 4 or above3. Educational and age requirements: High school graduate, no more than 26 years old
